sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology reclaims the top market rank with surging momentum, while overall market breadth remains extremely narrow with Healthcare standing as the sole, yet fragile, "all-green" sector.

Technology has rotated back into the leadership position, gaining 2 spots to rank 1st overall with a dominant momentum score of 0.82. Real Estate and Financials are also showing positive rotation, each climbing 1 spot over the last 5 sessions. Healthcare has climbed 1 spot to rank 9th and represents the only sector in the market displaying positive breadth across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).

Conversely, defensive and cyclical areas are fading. Communication Services led the decliners by dropping 2 spots to rank 10th with a weak 0.25 momentum score. Industrials and Energy also showed signs of exhaustion, each slipping 1 spot in rank despite their relatively high YTD rankings. 

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 1 of 11 groups—Healthcare (momentum 0.55)—is currently "all-green" across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD timeframes.
* **Technology Reclaims the Lead:** Technology gained 2 spots to take the rank 1 position, backed by the market's highest momentum score of 0.82.
* **Real Estate Rising:** Real Estate climbed 1 spot to rank 4th, supported by a strong momentum score of 0.65.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Technology led rank improvements (+2 spots, rank 1, momentum 0.82), followed by Financials (+1 spot, rank 8, momentum 0.57) and Healthcare (+1 spot, rank 9, momentum 0.55).
* **Top Losers:** Communication Services fell the furthest (-2 spots, rank 10, momentum 0.25), while Industrials (-1 spot, rank 3, momentum 0.70) and Energy (-1 spot, rank 2, momentum 0.48) also retreated.
* **Momentum Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical remains the weakest sector in the market, anchored at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.17.

## Divergences
* **Fragile Healthcare Strength:** Although Healthcare is the only sector with an all-green profile, its setup is highly unstable with a low agreement score of 0.47.
* **Industrials Fading:** Industrials are exhibiting a negative divergence, slipping 1 spot in rank over the last 5 days despite maintaining a strong momentum score of 0.70.
* **Energy Exhaustion:** Energy ranks 2nd YTD but is losing near-term steam, dropping 1 spot this week with its momentum score sliding to 0.48.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Tech hardware and heavy industrial machinery maintain absolute market leadership, while precious metals and defense experience a sharp weekly sell-off in favor of surging biotechnology, airlines, and residential construction.

Industrial and tech manufacturing remain the bedrock of market strength, with 32 of 144 groups holding "all-green" status (positive across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD frames). Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.94 momentum) and Electronic Components (0.93 momentum) lead the charge alongside Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.93 momentum). Meanwhile, a high-velocity rotation is underway, with capital flooding into Biotechnology (up 25 spots to rank 64), Airlines (up 24 spots to rank 49), and Residential Construction (up 22 spots to rank 62).

Conversely, defensive and commodity-linked sectors are fading rapidly. Precious metals took a severe hit over the last five sessions, with Silver plunging 59 spots (rank 88, 0.31 momentum) and Gold dropping 40 spots (rank 120, 0.20 momentum). Aerospace & Defense also plummeted 38 spots to rank 73. At the absolute bottom of the market, secular laggards like Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.022 momentum) and Application Software (0.113 momentum) show no signs of recovery.

## Strength
* **All-Green Breadth:** 32 of 144 industry groups maintain positive performance across all timeframes, anchored by Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.94 momentum) and Electronic Components (0.93 momentum).
* **Sustained Leaders:** Heavy industrials and tech infrastructure show persistent multi-month strength, notably Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.93 momentum) and Electronics & Computer Distribution, alongside cyclical pockets like REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.86 momentum).
* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Electrical Equipment & Parts shows robust long-term backing with a momentum score of 0.92, ranking 3rd YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Biotechnology (+25 spots, rank 64, momentum 0.74), Airlines (+24 spots, rank 49, momentum 0.84), and Residential Construction (+22 spots, rank 62, momentum 0.73) led the weekly velocity gains.
* **Top Losers:** Precious metals and defense collapsed, with Silver plunging 59 spots (rank 88), Gold dropping 40 spots (rank 120), and Aerospace & Defense falling 38 spots (rank 73).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.942) and Electronic Components (0.935) lead the market, while Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.022) and IT Services (0.077) remain anchored at the absolute bottom.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Several high-momentum groups are starting to slip in rank, including Capital Markets (momentum 0.65, -8 spots), Steel (momentum 0.66, -7 spots), and Trucking (momentum 0.72, -3 spots).
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Under-the-radar industries are jumping in rank despite low absolute momentum, led by Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+15 spots, momentum 0.47), Waste Management (+10 spots, momentum 0.47), and Health Information Services (+10 spots, momentum 0.47).
